checks: A delegated purchase creates one actionable approval task; receipt is blocked until authorization; approval executes the source exactly once
Invoice recognition has its own Finance authorization and balanced proposal; receiving is a separate inventory event
Backend action permissions and business-unit isolation reject unauthorized mutations
Warehouse transfers preserve total owned stock; wastage reduces stock and overdraw is rejected
Actual confirmed production consumes the existing BOM at warehouse level, records cost once, retains batch/lot links and feeds finished-unit cost
Expected packaging preview is read-only; confirmed actual use plus wastage reconciles to stock, finished cost and one waste-expense proposal
Controlled production void restores used and wasted material at original locations, retains unique movement IDs and reverses its accounting proposal
Insufficient production input is rejected without partial material consumption
Required payment approval defers the real debit; an independent Finance checker verifies and Posting Control posts one balanced payment
Purchase evidence is durable and opens through the existing authenticated attachment viewer
